verdict.rationale: BVNK's docs show a business can create crypto wallets for its own account and send, receive, store and convert funds, with stablecoin balances referenced, so the core of holding a stablecoin balance is there. Geography is stated only as a broad "130+ countries" claim, and nothing describes the custodial model, availability conditions or eligibility gating. Missing for 10: explicit custodial-account terms, per-geography availability for stablecoin balances, documented gating or eligibility requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, my business can hold a stablecoin balance on the platform — documented custodial accounts with stated availability, geographies, and any gating quoted honestly

citations.quote: Specify a customer's ID and reference to create wallets for them; otherwise, the wallet is created for your own account.
Send, receive, store, and convert funds across 130+ countries.
Use your fiat balance to send stablecoins, or fund in stablecoins and pay out in fiat.
Link virtual cards to stablecoin balances.
